title: Aurora Grove
text: Aurora Grove is a realm where time slows, light bends, and ancient trees whisper forgotten stories to those patient enough to listen.

title: Chrono Forge
text: Chrono Forge melds brass and steam with temporal gears; machines remember futures and craftsmen shape the flow of minutes.

title: Tidal Circuit
text: Tidal Circuit is a coastal arena where waves power luminous machines and sailors race between glowing buoys.

title: Lumen Bazaar
text: Lumen Bazaar glows with lantern strings and story-stalls; every idea is a trade between wonder and craft.

title: Mythic Atrium
text: Mythic Atrium is an archive of prophecy: marble hush, star maps, and experiments refined until they feel inevitable.
